headline: At least 132 killed in Colombia's largest earthquake in years
summary: A powerful 7.4 magnitude earthquake has killed at least 132 people in Colombia. The quake, the largest in years, had its epicenter in Chocó province. Tremors were felt hundreds of kilometers away in major cities across the region.
